basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Project Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 12 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur, through its Sponsored Research and Industrial Consultancy, has invited online applications for 12 Project Research Assistant - Research posts in the temporary research project "Centre of Excellence for Unified AI-Enabled Craft Ecosystem Platform" (Project Code R/CXA), sponsored by the Office of the Development Commissioner (Handicrafts), Ministry of Textiles, Government of India. Pay is consolidated compensation of up to Rs. 37000 per month, depending on qualification and experience, for a tenure of 12 months or the termination of the project, whic

age_limit.details: The prescribed qualifications and experience are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

qualification.details: BE / B.Tech / MA / M.Sc / MCA / MBA or equivalent degree; OR B.Sc./B.A./B.Com or equivalent degree with 2 years of relevant experience; OR 3-year Diploma with 5 years of relevant experience; OR In exceptional cases, those with ITI (2-year course) in a trade with more than 8 years of relevant experience may be considered with prior approval and justification. A Skill Test will be required.

how_to_apply: Apply online against advertisement no. IIT/SRIC/R/CXA/2026/121 on or before 7 December 2026.

The notice states that the application fee is to be deposited through RTGS/NEFT/NET Banking etc. to this account: State Bank of India (00202), P.O: Kharagpur Technology, Dist: Midnapore, West Bengal-721302; account name IIT SRIC-OM Account; account no. 39502115210; IFSC code SBIN0000202; SWIFT code SBININBB339.
Mention the transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) in the Application Form.
The notice does not list the documents to attach.

rows.details: Centre of Excellence for Unified AI-Enabled Craft Ecosystem Platform (Project Code – R/CXA)
Office of the Development Commissioner (Handicrafts), Ministry of Textiles, Government of India
12 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier
Up to Rs. 37000 per month (consolidated, depending on qualification and experience)
Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: BE / B.Tech / MA / M.Sc / MCA / MBA or equivalent degree; OR B.Sc./B.A./B.Com or equivalent degree with 2 years of relevant experience; OR 3-year Diploma with 5 years of relevant experience; OR In exceptional cases, those with ITI (2-year course) in a trade with more than 8 years of relevant experience may be considered with prior approval and justification. A Skill Test will be required. Knowledge of Computer applications; secretarial experience for Technical and Ministerial. A minimum of 80% marks (or a CGPA of 8.0/10) in Classes 10, 12 and the Bachelors degree program is desired. Candidates with a valid GATE score in Computer Science or a related discipline are strongly preferred. The prescribed qualifications and experience are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The tenure is 12 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. The notice does not mention HRA or other allowances.

rows.pay: Consolidated compensation (per month): up to 37000, depending on qualification and experience

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Kharagpur Project Research Assistant - Research
content_sections.text: The notice does not list the documents to attach.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice refers to an interview, and states that meeting the minimum qualification and experience does not entitle a candidate to be called for it. For the exceptional ITI case (more than 8 years of relevant experience), prior approval and justification are needed and a Skill Test will be required. The notice does not give the interview date or mode.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT Kharagpur Project Research Assistant - Research recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice lists 12 posts of Project Research Assistant - Research.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: A BE / B.Tech / MA / M.Sc / MCA / MBA or equivalent degree; or B.Sc./B.A./B.Com with 2 years of relevant experience; or a 3-year Diploma with 5 years of relevant experience. ITI with more than 8 years of relevant experience may be considered in exceptional cases.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years, as on the last date of the advertisement. Age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules, if any.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 37000 per month, depending on qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The notice shows the fee as Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Applications are invited online. Mention the transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) in the Application Form.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the job?
faq.answer: The tenure is 12 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. The assignment is temporary.

faq.question: Q9. Is a GATE score compulsory?
faq.answer: No. The notice says a valid GATE score in Computer Science or a related discipline is strongly preferred, not required.

faq.question: Q10. Is a Skill Test required?
faq.answer: A Skill Test is required for the exceptional case of ITI (2-year course) candidates with more than 8 years of relevant experience.
